terbaru.judul: Exploiting Liquidity Exhaustion Attacks in Intent-Based Cross-Chain Bridges
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose a new class of attacks called \emph{liquidity exhaustion attacks} and a replay-based parameterized attack simulation framework.

terbaru.judul: push0: Scalable and Fault-Tolerant Orchestration for Zero-Knowledge Proof Generation
terbaru.pelajaran: We present push0, a cloud-native proof orchestration system that decouples prover binaries from scheduling infrastructure.
